## Change

## Validation

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated user and developer docs where needed.
- [ ] I checked source preservation, collisions, failure cleanup, and cancellation when file operations changed.
- [ ] I recorded versions, checksums, licenses, and notices when dependencies changed.
- [ ] I measured the relevant workload when performance-sensitive code changed.
